calculate_rmsd_between_structures: calculate the RMSD between ORCA-optimized and MLIP-optimized atomic structures after minimizing rotation and translation
compute_interaction_energy_and_forces: compute interaction energy and forces for a supersystem like a ligand-pocket complex from component results
evaluate_ligand_pocket_metrics: evaluate MAE metrics for energy, forces, interaction energy, and interaction forces comparing ORCA and MLIP ligand pocket results
evaluate_ligand_strain_metrics: evaluate strain energy MAE and global minimum RMSD comparing ORCA and MLIP ligand strain results
evaluate_singlepoint_metrics: evaluate energy MAE, energy per atom MAE, and forces MAE comparing ORCA and MLIP single-point results
